filename.description: Source text file, relative to the documents root WITHOUT a 'documents/' prefix (e.g. 'meeting-DE.txt'). Use list_files first if you are unsure of the path.

output_filename.description: Optional output path. Default: same folder, '<name>.mp3'. Use a '.wav' suffix to skip the MP3 encode.

voice.description: Voice name from list_narrator_voices. Default: the narrator voice set for the engine, otherwise its first voice.

language.description: Language code of the text (e.g. 'de', 'en'). Default 'de'.

engine.description: Optional TTS engine key. Default: the topmost active entry of the TTS list.

speaker_voices.description: Optional multi-voice mapping: speaker label → voice name (from list_narrator_voices). Lines in the source file starting with '[LABEL]:' switch to that speaker's voice (the marker itself is not spoken); text before the first marker uses the default voice.
